annotation.title_clean: Uchwała nr 196 Rady Ministrów z dnia 28 grudnia 2020 r. w sprawie ustanowienia „Polityki dla rozwoju sztucznej inteligencji w Polsce od roku 2020”
annotation.title_en: Resolution No. 196 of the Council of Ministers of 28 December 2020 establishing the "Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Rada Ministrów Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej (Council of Ministers of Poland)
annotation.venue: Monitor Polski (Dziennik Urzędowy RP), poz. 23, 12 January 2021
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Polish Council of Ministers resolution adopting the national AI Policy 2020. It sets short-, medium- and long-term goals across society, firms, science, education, international cooperation and the public sector. It is innovation-focused and aligned with EU Trustworthy AI. It has limited embodied content: testing zones for autonomous vehicles and drones, liability, and opposition to AI legal personality.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Polish AI Policy; the minister for digitisation implements it and reports annually to the Council of Ministers.
Plans regulatory testing zones for autonomous land, water and air vehicles to clarify liability of algorithm creators, vehicle makers and operators.
Mandatory ex-ante self-assessment and model explanations for public-administration AI use.
Legal framework directions: oppose legal personality for AI; due-care liability for AI producers and risk-based liability for operators.
Creates coordinating bodies: AI Task Force, AI Contact Point, Labour Market Observatory, AI Council and a legislative team.
